lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li8Fe8O12 (reduced formula Li2Fe2O3) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over eight independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Fe centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors (1.93–2.00 Å), while Li centers show six-coordinate oxygen environments (2.06–2.26 Å) and O centers are octahedrally coordinated by mixed Fe and Li neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between FeO6 octahedra and between FeO6 and LiO6 six-vertex polyhedra.
